title: Minecraft Potion
blurb: The glassy fizz of a potion going down is the sound of a player who has finally decided to take a fight seriously. Brewing in Minecraft is fiddly enough — nether wart, blaze powder, a stand that wants fuel — that actually drinking one feels like an event rather than a chore. Fire resistance before the Nether, night vision before a cave dive, strength before a raid. The clip has a satisfying tail on it, which makes it useful anywhere you need a drink or a transformation to sound like it definitely worked.
origin: The potion drinking sound from Minecraft.
